questions.text: A student reads that homicide accounts for 51.0% of deaths among rap musicians and 51.5% among hip hop musicians, against 6.0% across all genres, and concludes that rap is an exceptionally dangerous profession. Which cautions below are sound?
options: At least half of all rap and hip hop musicians who have ever lived are still alive, so the observed deaths are a small and unrepresentative slice
The distortion is more severe the younger the genre
Dying violently or unusually may itself contribute to fame, which affects who enters the sample at all
The figures are expressed as rates per 100,000 musicians, so the comparison across genres is adjusted
correct_answer: At least half of all rap and hip hop musicians who have ever lived are still alive, so the observed deaths are a small and unrepresentative slice
The distortion is more severe the younger the genre
Dying violently or unusually may itself contribute to fame, which affects who enters the sample at all

questions.text: The assembly stage of Cleveland's three visual operations draws on the Gestalt laws of perceptual organisation. Which of the following pairs a law with its correct statement?
options: Closure — the mind continues visual, auditory and kinetic patterns
Continuity — the mind perceives a set of individual elements as a single, recognisable pattern
Common fate — elements that share a direction of movement are perceived as belonging together
Invariance — the mind recognises simple objects independent of rotation, translation, scale, deformation and lighting
correct_answer: Common fate — elements that share a direction of movement are perceived as belonging together
Invariance — the mind recognises simple objects independent of rotation, translation, scale, deformation and lighting

questions.text: Lakshmi's team is rebuilding the state public health dashboard. Its main screen tracks weekly dengue case counts across fourteen districts, and the audience is district health officers who open it each Monday morning. The current version renders each district as a 3D bar chart on a tinted panel, one district per screen, with a caption block beneath. Which of the team's proposed changes follow Tufte's principles for graphical excellence?
options: Printing the week the monsoon broke directly onto the outbreak curve, instead of noting it in the caption block below
Replacing the fourteen district series with a single state-wide weekly total, so that officers have less to read
Showing all fourteen districts as small multiples on one screen against a shared axis, so profiles can be compared across the state at a glance
Replacing the 3D bars with flat bars and removing the tinted panel background, since neither carries a value that would be lost by erasing it
Encoding weekly cases as the width of a rectangle and weekly growth rate as its height, so both variables travel in a single mark
Deleting the axis tick labels and district names, since removing ink always raises the data-ink ratio
correct_answer: Printing the week the monsoon broke directly onto the outbreak curve, instead of noting it in the caption block below
Showing all fourteen districts as small multiples on one screen against a shared axis, so profiles can be compared across the state at a glance
Replacing the 3D bars with flat bars and removing the tinted panel background, since neither carries a value that would be lost by erasing it
